column1: # rbac_policy.csv — RBAC policy for ev-server Scala microservices.
# Derived from AuthorizationsDefinition.ts (TypeScript source of truth).
#   Admin       — tenant-wide access; ABAC layer enforces LocalIssuer filter
#   SiteAdmin   — extends Basic; site management within assigned sites
#   SiteOwner   — extends Basic; read/report access for owned sites
#   Basic       — own resources only (OwnUser/AssignedSites ABAC filters)
# enforced at application layer in CasbinAuthorizationService.buildFilter().
# This file is purely the RBAC gate (can this role act on this resource at all?).
# ── Admin: tenant-wide access (ABAC handles LocalIssuer restrictions) ────────
# SiteAdmin — additional grants on top of Basic (inherited via g
# Tag — site admin can assign/unassign tags
# User — site admin can manage users within their sites
# SiteArea — full management within assigned sites
# ChargingStation — full OCPP control within assigned sites
# Statistic — site-scoped statistics (both enum names for compatibility)
# SiteOwner — additional grants on top of Basic
# User — read users within owned sites
# Basic — own data only (OwnUser / AssignedSites ABAC filters applied)
# Allow rows below close gaps against the TypeScript authorization matrix;
# deny rows override grants leaking through role inheritance or wildcards.
